Working with affected users, the team found and fixed three issues — skills written for earlier models firing too often and even preventing the model from checking its own work; an opt-in context-management experiment causing early stops or replies to stale messages (roughly 4-5k users affected, now disabled); and a set of badly configured serving engines producin…
featured.insightZh: OpenAI 的 Codex/ChatGPT 负责人 Thibault Sottiaux 这周做了一件业内少见的事：公开复盘 Astra 的质量问题并列出具体根因。他说团队和部分用户一起排查后，定位并修复了三类问题——为旧模型写的 skills 触发过于频繁，甚至会阻止模型自查工作；一个默认开启的上下文管理实验会导致提前中止或回复到更早的消息（粗估影响 4-5k 用户，现已关闭）；还有一批配置错误的推理引擎，导致长尾流量上出现可测量的质量退化。他形容修复后「follow-through 更一致、对最新消息的跟踪更准、执行过程中的自查更到位」。同一周他还晒了 Astra 驱动下的发布密度：Images 2.5、GPT-Live-1、Agents API、Data Agent、ChatGPT for Financial Services——而这还没到 DevDay。另外 OpenAI 收编了 Git AI 团队（Aidan 和 Sasha），该团队做的开源工具用于量化编码 agent 对代码库的实际贡献，Sottiaux 承诺 Git AI 将继续保持开源。这条线很有意思：企业开始需要「证明 Codex 到底帮我们做了什么」的…

featured.title: Madhu Guru · Meta AI 高级总监，前 Google Gemini/Veo/Nano Banana 负责人
featured.summaryEn: Meta AI senior director Madhu Guru — previously the Google lead for Gemini, Veo, and Nano Banana — offered a sharp three-part diagnosis of why most enterprise AI efforts fail. First, running old playbooks: the CEO taps a trusted lieutenant to head a central AI team staffed with trusted people from across the company, and the skill gap kills it. Fifteen years of incremental product development doesn't transfer; AI requires experimentation and invention. Second, chronic under-investment in evals — most enterprises d…
featured.insightZh: Meta AI 高级总监、前 Google Gemini/Veo/Nano Banana 负责人 Madhu Guru 给「企业 AI 为什么大面积失败」下了三条相当锋利的诊断。第一，用老剧本干新事：CEO 找一个信得过的副手牵头成立中央 AI 团队，再从各部门抽调亲信——问题在技能断层。过去十五年产品开发主要是增量优化，而 AI 要的是实验和发明，原来的团队结构、产品模式、发布与学习方法都不适配。第二，评测（evals）投入严重不足——大多数企业根本不理解 evals 的重要性，也不知道「做得好」长什么样。第三，从外部替公司造 AI：中央团队自封平台团队，造一堆要求全公司采纳的工具，这些产品往往脱离真实工作流、脱离一线的上下文和判断力，结果是勉强采用但拿不到实际生产力提升。他给的解法同样具体：招真正做成过 AI 产品的负责人（既要技术/产品深度，也要能赢得那些工作将被重塑的人的信任）；把 evals 当一等公民；把最好的 AI builder 嵌进要转型的业务职能里——是「和财务一起建」「和销售一起建」「和客服一起建」，不是「为他们建」。

featured.title: Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong 谈 Everything Exchange、代理化金融与代币化
featured.summaryEn: Coinbase is treating "bank accounts for AI agents" as a core business line — because 76% of agentic e-commerce transactions are under 30 cents, and the flat card fee alone is 30 cents, so legacy payment rails simply don't work at that size. Brian Armstrong, co-founder and CEO of Coinbase and co-founder of longevity company New Limit, breaks Coinbase into three lines: the Everything Exchange (stocks, commodities, crypto, perps, and prediction markets in one venue with shared liquidity and cross-margin), stablecoin payments (growing fast even when Bitcoin is down — "under one second, under one cent to move money anywhere in the world"), and what he calls Agentic Finance, or AIFi. The agentic finance thesis is the part enterprises should watch. In his words: "We don't want the AIs to be unbanked. If we want to bank the AIs, they deserve financial services as well." One prompt pasted into y…
featured.insightZh: Coinbase 正在把「给 AI agent 开户」当成一条主线业务——因为 76% 的 agent 电商交易金额低于 30 美分，而信用卡的固定费就是 30 美分，传统支付轨道在这个量级上根本不成立。 Brian Armstrong 是 Coinbase 联合创始人兼 CEO，同时也是抗衰老公司 New Limit 的联创。他把 Coinbase 当下拆成三条线：Everything Exchange（股票、商品、加密、永续合约、预测市场汇入同一处，共享流动性和跨品种保证金）、稳定币支付（即使比特币价格下跌也在持续高速增长，「一秒内、一美分以下把钱送到世界任何地方」），以及他称为 Agentic Finance / AIFi 的第三条线。 Agentic Finance 的逻辑最值得企业侧关注。Armstrong 的原话是：「我们不希望 AI 是没有银行账户的（We don't want the AIs to be unbanked）。如果要给 AI 开户，它们也理应获得金融服务。」具体做法是一行 prompt 粘进你的 agent，它就拥有自属的自托管钱包账户——没有 KYC 流程，因为「AI agent 没有政府身份证，至少在有人形机器人陪同之前还走不进银行网点」。Coinbase 同时提供两种形态：与人类身份绑定的、资金隔离的 agent 子账户，以及面向任意 agent 的完全自托管钱包（后者甚至可以自己募资、发币）。支撑这套的是 X402 协议——由 Coinbase 孵化后捐给 Linux 基金会，目前 Google、Cloudflare、AWS 都在参与。这些微交易的真实用途是信息采购：VC 的付费墙数据调研、招聘方抓取 LinkedIn，以及大量 agent 向专业化 agent 购买数据，本质上就是一次 tool call。 第二个值得抄的是 Coinbase 内部的「递归自我改进」实践。他们给每个团队、每个代码仓库、甚至每个人都建了一个 brain——内容是该服务所有历史事故、必须执行的财务控制、跑过的所有 A/B 实验、完整的 PR 接受/拒…

items.title: Peter Yang · Roblox 产品负责人、AI 教程创作者
items.summaryEn: Roblox product lead and AI tutorials creator Peter Yang pushed back hard on the "software factory" hype. His position: outside of verification and testing, AI isn't at a point where it can self-improve a product or build a new feature end-to-end without a human in the loop. The evidence is his own practice — whenever he loops an agent overnight to build something new, one wrong assumption early turns the entire run into wasted tokens. He closed with a challenge that's genuinely hard to answer: name a product or fe…
items.insightZh: Roblox 产品负责人、AI 教程创作者 Peter Yang 公开质疑当下热炒的「软件工厂（software factories）」概念。他的立场很直接：除了验证和测试环节，他不认为 AI 已经到了可以在无人介入的情况下自我改进产品、或端到端造出一个新功能的程度。理由来自他自己的实践——每次让 agent 通宵 loop 去造新东西，只要中间有一个假设判断错了，整条链路产出的就全是废 token。他最后抛出一个很难回答的公开挑战：到底有哪个产品或功能，是完全由软件工厂端到端造出来、没有人类定义需求、也没有人类检查产出的？另外他分享了自己的 agent 工具分工决策：本地定时任务全部收归 Codex，云端任务全部迁到 Grok Bot，理由是这样切分足够干净。

items.title: Thariq · Anthropic Claude Code 团队
items.summaryEn: Thariq from Anthropic's Claude Code team shipped plugin evals to address a specific pain point: after a new model release, you have no way to know whether your skills still work. Run `claude plugin eval init` in your plugin folder to get started. He added a broader caution for anyone reading benchmarks: it's basically impossible to interpret evals by looking at pass/fail scores alone these days — many of the failures he sees in benchmarks come from overly strict hidden tests, and in some cases the model's answer m…
items.insightZh: Anthropic Claude Code 团队的 Thariq 发布了 plugin evals，解决一个具体痛点：模型一更新，你就不知道自己写的 skills 还能不能正常工作。现在在 plugin 目录里跑 `claude plugin eval init` 即可初始化评测。他还补了一条关于评测本身的判断，值得所有在看 benchmark 的人留意：如今光看通过/失败分数基本无法解读评测结果——他在 benchmark 里看到的大量「失败」其实源于隐藏测试过于严苛，有些情况下模型给出的答案反而比评测预期的标准答案更合理。

items.title: Amjad Masad · Replit CEO
items.summaryEn: Replit CEO Amjad Masad announced that Replit acquired a business built entirely on Replit, adding "I expect first of many to come." The signal matters more than the deal: when a development platform starts acquiring companies grown on top of it, the platform has become capable of incubating independently viable products — and is converting ecosystem success directly into its own assets. He also shipped Routines with budgets (scheduled/automated tasks with spend controls) and noted a wave of Astra 3D experiments ap…
items.insightZh: Replit CEO Amjad Masad 宣布 Replit 收购了一家完全在 Replit 上构建起来的公司，并表示「这会是众多此类交易中的第一笔」。这个信号比单笔收购本身更重要：当一个开发平台开始收购生长在自己平台上的业务，说明平台已经能孵化出具备独立商业价值的产品，同时平台方也在把生态的成功直接转化为自身资产。他同期还发布了带预算控制的 Routines（定时/自动化任务），并提到平台上出现了大量 Astra 3D 相关的实验项目。

items.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
items.summaryEn: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch revealed that Tailscale's model router runs on Vercel AI Gateway as its underlying infrastructure, and offered an analogy worth bringing into architecture discussions: "AI Gateways are the new CDNs." The argument mirrors how CDNs became default — you could go "direct to origin" (straight to model provider APIs), but it's brittle; you could DIY, but it's painful and costly. For enterprise architecture the implication is clear: multi-model routing, failover, rate limiting, and observabilit…
items.insightZh: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 公布 Tailscale 的 model router 底层由 Vercel AI Gateway 驱动，并提出了一个值得放进架构讨论的类比：「AI Gateway 就是新的 CDN。」他的论证跟当年 CDN 的普及逻辑完全一致——你当然可以直连 origin（直接打模型厂商 API），但那样很脆；你也可以自己 DIY 一套网关，但既痛苦又昂贵。对企业架构来说，这条类比暗示的是：多模型路由、failover、限流、可观测性正在从「自建组件」沉淀为「基础设施层采购项」。

items.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
items.summaryEn: Box CEO Aaron Levie highlighted a new capability: you can now mount Box into agent sandboxes, making it far easier for an agent to read and write files on the agent's own computer. The framing is more valuable than the feature: as AI agents execute critical workflows in the enterprise, they're going to need the same primitives people have always had — file systems, permissions, storage, audit trails. The next competitive front in enterprise AI may be less about model capability and more about who delivers this "em…
items.insightZh: Box CEO Aaron Levie 介绍了一项新能力：现在可以把 Box 挂载（mount）到 agent 的沙箱环境里，让 agent 在自己的「电脑」上直接读写文件。他给出的框架比功能本身更值得记：随着 AI agent 开始在企业里执行关键工作流，它们需要的是和人类员工同等的原语（primitives）——文件系统、权限、存储、审计。企业 AI 落地的下一阶段竞争点，可能不在模型能力，而在于谁能把这些「员工基础设施」完整地交付给 agent。

items.title: Ryo Lu · Cursor 设计负责人，前 Notion / Stripe
items.summaryEn: Ryo Lu, who designs Cursor and previously worked at Notion and Stripe, announced long-lived agents are now in Cursor, positioned for "your big ideas." It makes an interesting counterpoint to Peter Yang's software-factory skepticism in this same digest: the tooling side is pushing toward longer-horizon, more autonomous agents while practitioner feedback still says one wrong assumption wastes the whole run. On a personal note, he emptied his house, said his goodbyes, and moved to Taipei — "so far so great."
items.insightZh: Cursor 设计负责人、曾任职 Notion 与 Stripe 的 Ryo Lu 宣布 Cursor 上线 long-lived agents（长生命周期 agent），定位是「承载你的大想法」。这与本期 Peter Yang 对软件工厂的质疑形成一组有意思的对照：工具侧正在往更长时间跨度、更自主的 agent 推进，而实践侧的反馈仍是「一个错误假设就毁掉整轮」。另外他本人清空房子、告别旧生活搬到了台北，反馈是「目前为止非常好」。

items.title: Dan Shipper · Every CEO
items.summaryEn: Every CEO Dan Shipper is pushing a practice most enterprises should copy: moving model selection off public benchmarks and onto private, internal ones. His premise — better benchmark scores don't tell you much about how well a model does on your real work. For three years Every has run "vibe checks" on new models: long-form reviews based on hands-on testing against their actual work. Now they're doubling down and quantifying it. Team members Hammer and Nityesh built an internal platform where everyone creates pers…
items.insightZh: Every CEO Dan Shipper 在推进一件很多企业应该抄的做法：把「模型选型」从公开 benchmark 转向内部私有基准。他的判断是——更好的 benchmark 分数并不能说明模型在你的真实工作上表现如何。Every 过去三年一直用 vibe check 的方式评估新模型：每个新模型出来就基于团队真实工作做长篇的实操评测。现在他们决定加码并量化：团队成员 Hammer 和 Nityesh 搭了一个内部平台，让每个人基于自己的日常真实工作构建个人基准。他的原话是「我们的 vibe check 过去纯粹是 vibes，现在开始变得更量化了」。对企业而言这是一条可直接复制的路径：与其追榜单，不如把自己的高频任务沉淀成可重复跑的私有 eval 集。

items.title: Zara Zhang · 创业者、Follow Builders 作者
items.summaryEn: Builder and Follow Builders author Zara Zhang pushed back on the currently fashionable "one-person company" narrative. She grants the first half: thanks to AI, one person can do far more. But she argues the idea is overrated, and the constraint isn't capability — it's human. Building something new is a profoundly lonely experience. You need someone to brainstorm with, suffer with, celebrate with. Her conclusion is concrete: it becomes extremely easy to lose motivation when you haven't tied yourself to the mast alo…
items.insightZh: 创业者、Follow Builders 作者 Zara Zhang 对「一人公司」这个当下极流行的叙事泼了盆冷水。她承认前半段：有了 AI，一个人确实能做成多得多的事。但她认为这个概念被高估了，原因不在能力而在人性——从零做一件新东西是一段极其孤独的体验。你需要有人一起头脑风暴、一起受苦、一起庆祝。她的结论很具体：当你没有把自己和另一个人绑在同一根桅杆上时，失去动力会变得异常容易。

items.title: Nikunj Kothari · FPV Ventures 合伙人
items.summaryEn: FPV Ventures partner Nikunj Kothari described something happening inside venture that rarely gets articulated publicly: the attribution wars. Quoting "success has many fathers, but failure is an orphan," he says he never felt the weight of it until he watched extremely successful VCs fight over credit for hot deals. The mechanics explain why — large exits and markups are genuinely rare, and they're what you raise your next fund on. His prediction: over the next couple of years you'll see many names scrubbed or con…
items.insightZh: FPV Ventures 合伙人 Nikunj Kothari 描述了一线 VC 圈正在发生、但外部很少被讲清楚的事：归因战争。他引用「成功有很多父亲，失败是个孤儿」，说自己直到看见极成功的 VC 为热门案子的功劳归属而争，才真正体会到这句话的分量。机制上的原因很现实——大额退出和 markup 本身极其稀有，而下一期基金正是靠这些募出来的。他的预测是，未来两三年里会看到大量名字被抹掉或「顺手省略」，所有人都想修订历史、为最终跑出来的项目争一份功劳。受伤最重的是新兴 GP：他们能带给 LP 的只有 track record，而现在这份记录正在被系统性地稀释。他引用 Anjney Midha 的话说新一代终究会找到出路，但短期内他给的建议是：和你的创始人绑得更紧——他们才是真正的 reference check。

items.title: Peter Steinberger · OpenClaw 与 OpenAI，前 PSPDFKit 创始人
items.summaryEn: Peter Steinberger, now at OpenClaw and OpenAI, ran Astra in a cloud session playing Doom through CUA (Computer Use Agent), with the self-assessment: "Not quite AGI yet, but probably beats fly brain." Beyond the joke there's a real contribution — he submitted a patch to trycua to make keyboard input work reliably under Linux, calling the framework dope overall. Using old games as computer-use stress tests is quietly becoming an informal benchmark for how well agents actually operate a machine.
items.insightZh: OpenClaw 与 OpenAI 的 Peter Steinberger 在云端 session 里让 Astra 通过 CUA（Computer Use Agent）玩 Doom，自评「还不算 AGI，但大概已经强过果蝇的脑子」。玩梗之外有个实际贡献：他给 trycua 框架提交了一个 patch，修复了 Linux 下按键映射不可靠的问题，并称该框架整体相当出色。这类「拿老游戏当 computer-use 压力测试」的做法，正在成为评估 agent 真实操作能力的非正式基准。

items.title: Matt Turck · FirstMark Capital 合伙人，MAD Podcast 主持人
items.summaryEn: FirstMark Capital partner and MAD Podcast host Matt Turck republished an updated version of his personal 9/11 account. In 2001 he was the young co-founder of TripleHop Technologies, a ~25-person NYC startup building enterprise search with whatever AI existed then — roughly what Glean does today. Their office was on the 53rd floor of the North Tower, chosen almost by accident: they had also looked at a large office around the 104th floor with unbelievable views, but it felt like overreach for a seed-funded startup…
items.insightZh: FirstMark Capital 合伙人、MAD Podcast 主持人 Matt Turck 在 9/11 二十五周年之际重发并更新了他的亲历记述。2001 年他是纽约创业公司 TripleHop Technologies 的年轻联合创始人，团队约 25 人，用当时能用上的 AI 做企业搜索——按今天的坐标系大致相当于 Glean。他们的办公室在世贸中心北塔 53 层。选这层几乎是偶然：最初看的是 104 层那间视野极佳的大办公室，但对一家种子轮公司来说太勉强，电梯也太慢，于是选了更小更便宜的 53 层。8:46 飞机撞上北塔时他还在家——团队习惯晚睡晚起，9:30 才到公司。当天只有一位同事 Kenton Beerman 在办公室，受惊但平安脱险。让他至今记得的是团队的反应：那一天所有人都拼命在救业务。当时还没有 AWS，服务器就在办公室的机房里，幸好 CTO 团队做了完整备份——当天结束前系统基本恢复运行。9/11 也成了互联网泡沫破裂后压垮经济的最后一根稻草，接下来两年是彻底的核冬天；靠着 9/11 前几个月刚募到的 500 万美元 A 轮，公司撑到 2003-2004 年业务回暖，2005 年被 Oracle…

items.title: Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong 谈 Everything Exchange、代理化金融与代币化
items.summaryEn: Coinbase is treating "bank accounts for AI agents" as a core business line — because 76% of agentic e-commerce transactions are under 30 cents, and the flat card fee alone is 30 cents, so legacy payment rails simply don't work at that size. Brian Armstrong, co-founder and CEO of Coinbase and co-founder of longevity company New Limit, breaks Coinbase into three lines: the Everything Exchange (stocks, commodities, crypto, perps, and prediction markets in one venue with shared liquidity and cross-margin), stablecoin payments (growing fast even when Bitcoin is down — "under one second, under one cent to move money anywhere in the world"), and what he calls Agentic Finance, or AIFi. The agentic finance thesis is the part enterprises should watch. In his words: "We don't want the AIs to be unbanked. If we want to bank the AIs, they deserve financial services as well." items.insightZh: Coinbase 正在把「给 AI agent 开户」当成一条主线业务——因为 76% 的 agent 电商交易金额低于 30 美分，而信用卡的固定费就是 30 美分，传统支付轨道在这个量级上根本不成立。 Brian Armstrong 是 Coinbase 联合创始人兼 CEO，同时也是抗衰老公司 New Limit 的联创。他把 Coinbase 当下拆成三条线：Everything Exchange（股票、商品、加密、永续合约、预测市场汇入同一处，共享流动性和跨品种保证金）、稳定币支付（即使比特币价格下跌也在持续高速增长，「一秒内、一美分以下把钱送到世界任何地方」），以及他称为 Agentic Finance / AIFi 的第三条线。 Agentic Finance 的逻辑最值得企业侧关注。Armstrong 的原话是：「我们不希望 AI 是没有银行账户的（We don't want the AIs to be unbanked）。如果要给 AI 开户，它们也理应获得金融服务。」具体做法是一行 prompt 粘进你的 agent，它就拥有自属的自托管钱包账户——没有 KYC 流程，因为「AI agent 没有政府身份证，至少在有人形机器人陪同之前还走不进银行网点」。Coinbase 同时提供两种形态：与人类身份绑定的、资金隔离的 agent 子账户，以及面向任意 agent 的完全自托管钱包（后者甚至可以自己募资、发币）。支撑这套的是 X402 协议——由 Coinbase 孵化后捐给 Linux 基金会，目前 Google、Cloudflare、AWS 都在参与。这些微交易的真实用途是信息采购：VC 的付费墙数据调研、招聘方抓取 LinkedIn，以及大量 agent 向专业化 agent 购买数据，本质上就是一次 tool call。 第二个值得抄的是 Coinbase 内部的「递归自我改进」实践。他们给每个团队、每个代码仓库、甚至每个人都建了一个 brain——内容是该服务所有历史事故、必须执行的财务控制、跑过的所有 A/B 实验、完整的 PR 接受/拒…
